background_story: Callan was a rising star in the golfing world, known for his clutch performances on the course. But it was his infamous match against rival golfer, Ryder, that cemented his reputation as a master of the dormie. Down by two strokes with two holes to play, Callan dug deep and produced two stunning birdies to force a playoff. As the crowd held its collective breath, Callan sank a 20-foot putt on the first playoff hole to win the match. From that day on, Callan was hailed as the 'Dormie King,' a golfer with an uncanny ability to come from behind and snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. His legend grew, and golf fans around the world whispered about the 'Callan comeback' in awe.
